use default

row_of(n: int) -> LIST[bigint] is
    let row mut = LIST()
    row.add(1n)

    for step in 1::n do
        let following = LIST()
        following.add(0n)

        for k in 1::step do
            let above = if k < row.count then row[k] else 0n fi

            following.add(bigint(k) * above + row[k - 1])
        od

        row = following
    od

    row
si

write_line("Stirling numbers of the second kind, S2(n, k):")
write_line("")

let heading = LIST()
heading.add("{"n/k",3}")

for k in 0::12 do
    heading.add("{k,10}")
od

write_line(heading |> join(""))

for n in 0::12 do
    let row = row_of(n)
    let cells = LIST()
    cells.add("{n,3}")

    for value in row do
        cells.add("{value,10}")
    od

    write_line(cells |> join(""))
od

let largest =
    row_of(100) |> reduce(0n,
                          (best, v) => if v > best then v else best fi)

write_line("")
write_line("the largest S2(100, k):")
write_line("  {largest}")
